name: runner-service-handoff
goal: runIsolated hands a vetted, authenticated OS-managed service over to the system instead of signalling it: every signal path protects candidates, unknown never passes, private leaks still fail and are stopped.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: runIsolated signalled the command's group and every followed survivor, so a shared ibtoold was stopped on success, failure and timeout. Expected: vetted service handed over; possible ones never signalled, never passed.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Synthetic only. test/utils/settle-processes.test.ts (6d5409fb4a946588): 6 failed on the old runner; test/utils/platform-services.test.ts (7e8b76c6e28c23cf) failed, unit missing. /tmp/harness-handoff-red.log

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: src/utils/platformServices.ts, settleProcesses.ts (new); runIsolated.ts, processDescendants.ts; desktop ios-build-processes.ts. macOS only: no group signal, per-process judgement, outcome in the hashed log.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same unchanged files: runner 22 passed, record fixtures 15 passed, frozen desktop 9c196712 and 1ca5ded1 7 passed. /tmp/harness-handoff-green.log, /tmp/harness-handoff-desktop-green.log. No Xcode tool run.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
